dialogue.text: The first morning of the new school term -- and Aoi is already running late.
No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: exasperated

dialogue.text: At the station gate, a crowd bunches around the timetable board.
A red notice flashes: signal trouble. Trains are delayed.
Please don't say that...
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: holding_back_tears

dialogue.text: She checks the time, then grips her bag tighter.
If I miss the opening homeroom...
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: uneasy_confused

dialogue.text: When the train finally arrives, it is packed and slow.
By the time Aoi reaches school, the front gate is almost empty.
I'm sorry. I'm late.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: uneasy_confused

dialogue.text: She bows automatically to no one in particular and hurries inside.
The hallway is too quiet. Her shoes sound louder than usual.
Class 1-B... second floor, right?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: uneasy_confused

dialogue.text: She finds 1-B, slides the door open a little, and freezes.
...And that's all for the semester assembly notes.
dialogue.speaker: Teacher

dialogue.text: Thirty faces turn toward her.
S-sorry for interrupting...
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: uneasy_confused

dialogue.text: A beat passes. Then the teacher blinks.
You're Aoi Sakamoto? You're in 1-A. Next room over.
dialogue.speaker: Teacher

dialogue.text: A small ripple of laughter moves through the room.
Ah... right. I'm very sorry.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: uneasy_confused

dialogue.text: Her face burns as she slides the door shut again.
In the hall, she stands still for one painful second, staring at the floor.
I couldn't even be late correctly...
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: exasperated

dialogue.text: The next door opens before she can knock.
Are you from 1-A too?
dialogue.speaker: Mina

dialogue.text: A girl with a neat ponytail lifts a stack of handouts in one arm.
Y-yes. I mixed up the rooms.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: uneasy_confused

dialogue.text: Me too, earlier. Come on. Sensei already started, but he's nice.
dialogue.speaker: Mina

dialogue.text: The girl smiles like it's no big deal and steps aside.
Thank you...
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

dialogue.text: Inside 1-A, the teacher pauses only long enough to mark her attendance.
Train delay? Then sit down and catch up later. No need to panic.
dialogue.speaker: Teacher

dialogue.text: Aoi bows and slips into the only open seat—by the window, next to the ponytailed girl.
I'm sorry for causing trouble.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: holding_back_tears

dialogue.text: You didn't. Here, the printout. We just wrote our names and club interests.
dialogue.speaker: Mina

dialogue.text: Aoi takes the paper with both hands.
You saved me.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

dialogue.text: Then save me later if I forget something.
dialogue.speaker: Mina

dialogue.text: Aoi lets out a breath she feels she has been holding since the station.
Okay... I can do that.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

dialogue.text: Her handwriting is a little shaky as she writes her name, but the line comes out straight.
Maybe... this day isn't ruined after all.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile
